title: Preference rewards, KL regularization and RLHF

chapters.text: Start from the reference. Expected reward: 0.5; KL to reference: 0; Regularized objective: 0.5.
Tilt toward reward. Expected reward: 0.735; KL to reference: 0.0628; Regularized objective: 0.698.
Trade reward against divergence. Expected reward: 0.971; KL to reference: 0.221; Regularized objective: 0.838.
Normalize the tilted distribution. Expected reward: 1.21; KL to reference: 0.461; Regularized objective: 0.929.
Reach the analytic bandit optimum. Expected reward: 1.44; KL to reference: 0.795; Regularized objective: 0.965.
